dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: All 14 execution spans across rule context loading and ADR-to-pattern generation achieved 100% schema validation success under semantic contract v1.0 and associated schemas (rule_context_schema.json and pattern_schema.json), demonstrating total adherence to governance requirements.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The initial context established by the rules-context-loader span effectively seeded 13 distinct ADR pattern derivations. Token volume (>126k prompt tokens per pattern span) maintained context continuity, downstream traceability, and causal architectural justification throughout the execution chain.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Decision outputs consistently balanced architectural constraints against implementation patterns, translating complex input context into well-delimited pattern definitions with clearly reconciled boundary conditions and trade-offs.
